h2: Pool Equipment Sanur – Pumps, Filters & Chlorinators
intro: If you're searching for Pool Equipment Sanur help, chances are the culprit is either salt-air corrosion or brittle original pipework from a villa built in the late 90s or early 2000s. Bali Fix installs and repairs pumps, sand and cartridge filters, chlorinators, lights and auto-fill systems throughout Sanur Kaja, Sindhu and beyond — just send photos on WhatsApp and we'll sort it out.

sections.h3: Salt Air, Brackish Water & Ageing Fittings
sections.text: In Sindhu and Mertasari, homes sit close enough to the beach that chloride-laden air eats through pump motor housings, tap threads and hinge pins well before their expected lifespan. Add brackish well water or PDAM supply, and filter media clogs faster while heater elements build up scale. Original PVC joints from villas now fifteen to twenty years old have gone chalky and brittle; when one section cracks, swapping the whole run is usually cleaner than patching around it.

A pump that won't prime after a dry spell, a multiport valve weeping at the handle, a salt cell throwing error codes, pool lights flickering or dead, an auto-fill float stuck open flooding the skimmer — these are the calls that come in week after week across Sanur Kauh and Batujimbar. Filter sand that has lost its grit over the years needs replacing too. Send us what you're seeing and we'll advise whether it's a part swap or a full unit change.

sections.h3: Sending Photos on WhatsApp for a Quote
sections.text: No phone numbers to dial, no forms to fill. Snap two or three clear photos of the equipment — nameplate if visible, the leak point, any error display — and send them to our WhatsApp with a short note like 'pump noisy since Tuesday' or 'chlorinator light blinking red.' We look at what you've sent, tell you what we think the fix involves, and give a price based on that specific job. There's no flat-rate card; every quote reflects what's actually needed.

sections.h3: Keeping Your Pool Gear Lasting Longer in Sanur
sections.text: Because the air here carries salt and the sun is relentless year-round, a little routine goes a long way. Wipe down pump motors and valve handles monthly with a dry cloth to slow corrosion. Backwash your filter on schedule rather than waiting for pressure to spike — brackish water means the media loads up quicker than inland pools. If you notice PVC joints looking white or chalky near the pool deck, flag it early; a small section swap now beats a flood under the villa later.

faq.q: Do you service villas in all of Sanur?
faq.a: Yes — from Sanur Kaja through Sindhu, Semawang, Mertasari, Batujimbar and beyond. If your villa has a pool, we can get to it.

faq.q: How do I know if my filter sand needs replacing?
faq.a: If backwashing no longer clears the pressure gauge, or fine grit keeps showing up in the return jets even after a fresh cycle, the media has likely broken down. Send a photo of the filter housing and we'll confirm.

faq.q: Can you install a new salt chlorinator on an existing system?
faq.a: In most cases yes — we size the cell to match your flow rate and wire it into the current circuit. Photos of your pump and plumbing help us confirm compatibility before heading over.
